simple_sections.description: Live preview from the selected source.

buttons.description: Record every frame to a multi-page TIFF beside the photon data.
Finish the recording; the preview stays on.

sections.description: Live preview from the selected source.

sections.label: Source
sections.description: Camera index (for example 0), Matrix Vision device (mv:0), a video file, or a supported stream URL. The selected source is opened only when Connect is pressed.

buttons.label: Discover
buttons.description: List operating-system video devices without opening them. Device names do not determine OpenCV indices.

buttons.label: Matrix Vision
buttons.description: Select the first Matrix Vision SDK capture device.

buttons.label: Disconnect
buttons.description: Stop capture and close the source.

sections.label: Preview gain
sections.description: Brighten the live preview to inspect dim backreflection. Recorded image data is unchanged.

sections.label: Recording file
sections.description: New file for recorded frames. A name ending in .tif or .tiff records a multi-page TIFF: every captured frame becomes one page, needing no OpenCV. Any other name records a video file through the optional OpenCV package. Existing files are never overwritten; frame timestamps are saved alongside.

sections.label: AVI FPS
sections.description: Playback frame rate of an AVI or other video-file recording. A TIFF recording stores every captured frame with its own capture time, so this does not apply to it.

buttons.label: ⏺ Record
buttons.description: Record video frames and timestamps to a new file.

buttons.label: ⏹ Stop
buttons.description: Finish the video recording while keeping the preview open.
